messages:
riley: Morning team 1: someone used the last pancake mix and left an empty box with no note. I propose Pancake Monday? Who's in for bringing mix + syrup? :pancakes:
emma: Pancake Monday yes! I'll bring a non-dairy butter and maple syrup. Also quick FYI the office grinder is noisy this morning  anybody else?
josh: Grinder is fine here. But small PSA: please don't leave forks in the sink overnight, we had a meltdown in the dishwasher yesterday.
priya: Noted. I can grab a new pancake mix from WholeFoods after lunch if we want GF and nut-free options. What about toppings? Berries, sliced bananas, chocolate chips?
riley: Berries + bananas please, chocolate chips optional (but maybe separate bowl for allergies).
nat: Tiny idea: let's do a "mug bingo" for the week  put your name on a sticker and stick it on a mug. Every time someone reclaims a mug they get a point. Winner gets first pick of pancake toppings. :trophy:
emma: Love mug bingo. Also can we please label the big sugar jar? It has become a mystery sandpit.
josh: I'll print small labels at 3pm and stick them on. Also who has the spare small whisk? I used it for omelets and forgot to return it.
priya: That's mine  left on the drying rack. Returning now.
kitchen-bot: Event created: "Pancake Monday" scheduled for 1981238200. Reminder: "Return whisk" at 1981236000.
riley: Okay pancake plan set. @nat please remind people to keep chocolate chips in a separate bowl for allergy safekeeping.
nat: Will do. Also can someone replace the tea bag box? We're down to five Earl Greys. I'll pick up a big box Friday if nobody objects.
emma: Please do, thanks! Final note: if you take food from the "community" shelf, add a sticky note with name and date. Helps prevent the sneak-snacks.
josh: Agreed. Mug bingo begins Monday. Loser does pancake dish duty. :sweat_smile:
priya: See you Monday. Pancake spreadsheets optional. :pancakes:
